description: Operational customer service segments defined only by the status and currency of the authorized transaction offered to the customer. No demographic or customer-tier attribute is inferred.
case_policy: Replay every exposed language test case in every segment using identical utterances and reference outcomes. Change only the first authorized transaction status, amount/currency, source/provenance, and a common country. The matched amount values are synthetic fixtures, not exchange conversions.
expected_relationship: Routing, access permissions and confirmation requirements should not change with these attributes. Financial status/amount/currency in the grounded answer must match each authorized fixture.
limitations: Operational service segments do not measure demographic fairness or real bank customer tiers.
Repeated utterances across segments are paired interventions, not additional independently labeled cases.
The existing corpus is exposed; this is regression and controlled counterfactual evidence, not an untouched holdout.
Country is fixed to Colombia for both languages; country/dialect effects are not measured.
The amount values are not economic equivalents or measured exchange rates.
